title.en: Suction Piston Pumps and Hydraulic Camshafts

description.ar: مُصْطَلَحَاتُ مِضَخَّاتِ الرَّفْعِ ذَاتِ الأُسْطُوَانَتَيْنِ، وَأَعْمِدَةِ التَّحْوِيلِ الحَرَكِيِّ، وَصِمَامَاتِ عَدَمِ الرُّجُوعِ فِي هَنْدَسَةِ الجَزَرِيِّ.
description.de: Fachwortschatz zu doppeltwirkenden Kolbenpumpen, Bewegungswandler-Nockenwellen und Rückschlagventilen in der Ingenieurskunst von al-Dschazari.
description.en: Terminology of double-acting lift pumps, motion-converting camshafts, and non-return clack valves in al-Jazari's mechanical treatises.

example.ar: تَرْفَعُ مِضَخَّةُ المَاءِ ذَاتُ الأُسْطُوَانَتَيْنِ سُيُولَ النَّهْرِ إِلَى أَعْلَى الحِصْنِ دُونَ انْقِطَاعٍ.
example.de: Die doppeltwirkende Kolbenpumpe fördert das Flusswasser ohne Unterbrechung auf die Höhe der Festung.
example.en: The double-acting reciprocating suction pump lifts river currents up to the citadel continuously.

example.ar: يُحَوِّلُ عَمُودُ الكَامَاتِ الخَشَبِيُّ دَوَرَانَ النَّاعُورَةِ إِلَى حَرَكَةٍ مُسْتَقِيمَةٍ تَدْفَعُ المَكَابِسَ.
example.de: Die hölzerne Nockenwelle wandelt die Drehung des Schaufelrads in geradlinigen Kolbenantrieb um.
example.en: The wooden camshaft converts the waterwheel's rotation into linear motion driving the pistons.

example.ar: يَمْنَعُ صِمَامُ عَدَمِ الرُّجُوعِ الجِلْدِيُّ عَوْدَةَ المَاءِ إِلَى البِئْرِ أَثْنَاءَ ضَغْطِ الأُسْطُوَانَةِ.
example.de: Das lederne Rückschlagventil verhindert den Rückfluss des Wassers in den Brunnen während des Druckhubs.
example.en: The leather non-return clack valve prevents backflow of water into the well during the compression stroke.
